intro: Fresh, light and herb-heavy: aromatic broths, rice noodles, plates of herbs and dipping sauce, with a French-bread legacy.
flavours: Fish sauce (nước mắm), rice noodles, mint, coriander, lime, star anise

dishes.name: Phở
dishes.what: Rice noodle soup in a clear beef broth spiced with star anise and cinnamon, with herbs and lime on the side.

dishes.name: Bánh mì
dishes.what: Crackly baguette stuffed with pâté, cold cuts, pickled vegetables, chilli and coriander.

dishes.name: Bún chả
dishes.what: Hanoi's grilled pork patties in a sweet-sour dipping broth with rice vermicelli and herbs.

dishes.name: Gỏi cuốn
dishes.what: Fresh summer rolls of rice paper wrapped around prawns, pork, noodles and herbs.

dishes.name: Chả giò
dishes.what: Crispy fried spring rolls filled with pork, mushroom and glass noodles.

dishes.name: Bún bò Huế
dishes.what: Spicy lemongrass beef noodle soup from the old imperial city of Huế.

dishes.name: Cơm tấm
dishes.what: Saigon 'broken rice' with a grilled pork chop, egg meatloaf and fish sauce.

dishes.name: Bánh xèo
dishes.what: Crispy turmeric-coconut crêpe filled with prawns, pork and bean sprouts; wrap in lettuce to eat.

dishes.name: Cà phê sữa đá
dishes.what: Strong dripped coffee over condensed milk and ice.
